name: cobol-interface-header-dropped-clauses
body: parse_interface splits the header at the first USING and drops an INTERFACE-ID AS literal and IMPLEMENTS clause, since the Interface AST has no field for them; INHERITS names are read only before USING. Limit: an interface's external name and a USING placed before INHERITS are lost. Upgrade when the AST gains those fields or a source shows the other clause order.
